body:
It was winter sometime, I'm not sure on the date exactly, but me and my brother were down for combining our hits to make for an awesome roll. He had two Red Transformers, and I had two Green Apples, so we could combine one of each. We first popped the green apples at about 8:00pm
We were walking through the forest nearby to smoke some weed waiting for the comeup, and after a couple of bowls we started to feel wicked wacky, they were sold as 2-CB hits, but I suspect they may have been piprazines.
We got out of the forest at 8:45 feeling pretty good, so we decided to pop the Red Transformers next. The Red Transformers we had gotten from a friend who was selling them cheap, at $5 each. Where I'm from, transformers are notorious for being methy and crazy, so I wasnt really sure what to expect from combining them both.
We started walking towards downtown, to buy some more weed from a buddy, neither of us had vehicles. Halfway downtown, maybe 30 mins after taking the transformer, we both started getting real wacky. If me or my brother looked down, we looked like we were midgets. So we were walking along downtown fully believing we had become midgets.
There were puddles everywhere.
Looking down at them, they looked like an enormous lake that was pulling us into it, like a force of some sort, not to mention gravity was waaay off. As if something was pulling and pushing us around.
At about 10:00PM we reached a coffee shop, we decided to go inside and warm up. We went inside, got coffees, sat downbut I noticed that the walls were moving and bending, it was as if they were alive, then my brother said people were listening to us so we cleared out of there.
We began walking further downtown, and eventually made it to our dealer, and got our weed. We were going to smoke more but we figured we should wait till were home because it was freezing cold and we were both completely fucked up. So we took the trail home, but on our way I saw an airplane driving on the road, a fucking airplane, it didnt seem to bother me tho, like it was normal.
Hallucinations persisted, we kept seeing cars drive by us, but there was nobody on the roads, and people on the path, but there was nobody there. We were disoriented to shit, wondering around downtown in winter trying to get home. Every 5 minutes of walking we would stop and take a break, because we thought our hearts were going to explode. We also couldnt stop laughing the whole way home, every house, car, lightpost, or anything, looked either ridiculously big or small. We were discussing insanity, and confirming that this must be what insane people feel like all the time. We were completely out of our minds.
We were discussing insanity, and confirming that this must be what insane people feel like all the time. We were completely out of our minds.
We got home, at ??:?? Ran inside and into our sisters room, it was the only place that seemed safe because our parents were in the house and we couldnt calm down. I ran to the bathroom and puked an acid mixture of coffee, chemicals, and stomach acid. I stumbled through the hallway back to the room, the floors were wobbly, as well as the ceiling and wallseverything was moving.
I made it back to my sisters room, where my brother was dying on the floor with laughter, and my sister was filming him. I sat down, and every one of my muscles started vibrating furiously, I watched my hands and arms vibrate as the muscles moved around, my entire world was vibrating, and I was still having the time of my life. After laughing some more and talking with our sister, we went downstairs to watch tv and chill out.
We smoke a bowl in the bong, and watched family guy. The theme song itself was Terrifying. It sounded like it was going backwords and slow, we had to turn the volume off and put music on instead, but even the music sounded completely fucked, but better than the tv. We laid on the couches for a few hours, watching things that didnt make sense. Feeling the vibrations in my body shaking my thoughts. We would go in the basement for another bong sesh every 30 mins to an hour.
Eventually me and my brother were just laying on the couch, praying we would somehow fall asleep, or die. Anything would have felt better. We discussed suicide for a little while, not actually doing it, but just discussing it. Every time I looked at the staircase, I could see people and stuff on it, it was quite sketchy so I tried not to look at it much.
Eventually daylight hit and we were free. However we were very, very, strung out. Everything still seemed off, people looked scary from the corner of your eye, the gravity felt off. My mouth was chewed up like crazy, I tried not to talk much which wasnt hard because I didnt want to talk. Me and my bro made a pact to only do molly and not greasy E hits any more, it was too fucked of an experience. I have never felt so insane and and shitty in my life, even though it was fun for a bit.
We had no idea what was in those pills,  but we said fuck it! It was a life changing experience, I have never had a trip like that since and I dont want one.
